title: Parked-suite triage map
description: Committed, drift-guarded disposition for every file in the parked bun:test legacy corpus (issue #834). See docs/testing/parked-suite-triage.md for the narrative and scripts/test/parked-suite-triage.test.mjs for the guard that enforces this shape.

capturedAt.description: The git SHA the corpus counts in the .md narrative and issue #834/#839 were measured at.

path.description: Repo-relative path, e.g. tests/org-row-stores.test.ts. Must be unique across all entries.

lane.description: unit/e2e/manual mirror scripts/ci-shard.ts's own routing; support covers non-test files the map still accounts for (helpers, fixtures, harness modules, migration drivers, the bunfig preload).

cluster.description: The mechanical classifier's bucket (scripts/test/classify-parked-suites.mjs), verbatim, for unit-lane files. 'e2e' is used for the e2e/manual/support rows this story adds beyond the classifier's scope.

disposition.description: keep:active -- the file is healthy and should simply RUN; nothing is owed. Added by #1020 because every other value asserts work is owed, so a healthy file had to claim a debt it did not have. migrate:paths -- a real test whose relative imports point at a layout that no longer exists (the pre-monorepo repo-root `src/` tree). DISTINCT FROM retire:obsolete, which must keep meaning a decision someone made: a test whose imports moved is UNMIGRATED, not obsolete, and filing one as the other launders a maintenance gap into a deliberate retirement nobody revisits. See docs/testing/parked-suite-triage.md's Contract section for each value's `target` meaning.

target.description: Meaning depends on disposition -- see the enum table in docs/testing/parked-suite-triage.md's Contract section.

story.description: The story/epic id that executes this row.
